report:
Exact baseline: `6bea169553919a03cad0eb375e4189240ad9ddf4`, clean worktree. Authority is the committed residual packet `.ak/dockets/issues/10/apply/apply-001/residual-repairs/install-and-envelopes.md`, supported by the recheck Judge Receipt. I did not inspect sessions or modify files/Git. History shows `a9e7903` already installed the shared ordered lifecycle binder and an incomplete machine-heavy matrix; this repair will not add a parallel decoder/binder or weaken package leaf validators.

Behavior
1. A clean exact `npm install` must not rewrite tracked metadata: root `engines.node` must agree in `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (currently `>=20` versus `>=22`).
2. For each of the five terminating tools (`coder`, `fixer`, `reviewer`, `judge`, `collector`) and each supported envelope (`machine`, `session`), execute a lawful lifecycle control and negatives for replay/duplicate, ordering, error, non-exact acceptance text, unsupported shape/tool, and multiple-acceptance ambiguity. Negatives remain absence except ambiguity, which remains `RecorderError("extraction-failed")`. Collector keeps legs-only issuance versus full accepted receipt; Judge/Reviewer audit observations and all role behavior remain unchanged.

Owner
- Package/lock reproducibility: root package metadata in `package.json` and npm’s root package record in `package-lock.json`.
- Envelope parsing and lifecycle law: existing `src/recorder/extract.ts` seam; production changes only if the completed matrix exposes a real shared-decoder defect.
- Counterexample ownership: focused helpers/matrix in `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`; no scratch probe will remain.

Red
- First reshape the focused lifecycle fixture so the same scenario builder emits both supported envelope forms, including Collector’s distinct args/details contract.
- Add table-driven assertions over all 5 × 2 cells for lawful control, identical replay/duplicate terminal, start/terminal ordering violations, error terminal, prefix/suffix/truncated exact-text violations, unsupported envelope/tool lookalikes, and two distinct lawful candidates causing ambiguity. This closes the current defect where most negatives call only `machineLifecycle` and global unsupported/ambiguity checks cover only machine shapes.
- Demonstrate install drift at the metadata seam by comparing tracked status before/after exact clean `npm install` (the known red is the root lock engine rewrite).

Green
- Synchronize only the root engine declaration by regenerating/updating the lock through npm so it records the package’s authoritative `>=20` value; do not hand-edit dependency metadata.
- Make the matrix pass through the existing `decodeEnvelopeRows` → `collectLifecycleEvents` → `bindAcceptedLifecycle` path. If a cell fails because production treats the two documented envelopes differently, make the smallest fix in `src/recorder/extract.ts`; do not relax `acceptedTextFor`, `validateAcceptedDetails`, Collector closure, ordering, uniqueness, or ambiguity rules.
- Re-run exact clean `npm install` and assert `git status --short` is empty before implementation edits are considered; after edits, verify a second install produces no additional diff.

Scope
- Expected files: `package-lock.json` and `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`; `package.json` should remain `>=20` and is touched only if npm synchronization requires canonical formatting. `src/recorder/extract.ts` is conditional on a matrix-proven production defect.
- Explicitly excluded: Recorder publication/admission/metadata residual packets, Souls, schemas/leaf contracts, role runtime/behavior, README/authority/dockets, archived sessions, and unrelated cleanup.

Verification and delivery
- Run exact `npm install`, confirm no install-created tracked delta beyond the intended committed lock synchronization, then `npm run typecheck`, focused `node --import tsx --test test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`, full `npm test`, `npm run build:recorder`, and package gates (`node --import tsx --test test/*package-lifecycle.test.ts test/package-entrypoint.integration.test.ts` plus `npm pack --json`/installed-tarball coverage already exercised by those lifecycle tests). Finish with `git diff --check` scoped to this repair and clean-status accounting.
- Create exactly one new forward commit from baseline, proposed title `fix(recorder): complete envelope acceptance matrix`; no amend/rewrite. The commit body will identify lock reproducibility and the 5 × 2 counterexample closure and note that shared leaf/role behavior was preserved. Confirm new HEAD is a strict descendant and return the exact completed Fixer Receipt with commit SHA and gate results.
